invoiceTypes.name: Manpower Services
invoiceTypes.contentSignals: Manpower supply, welding/fabrication activity, headcount-based billing, manpower roles referenced (Welder, Fitter, Helper), manhour/timesheet language.

documents.classificationHints: Commercial invoice with Inv No, Date, Payment Terms, totals (Total Amount, VAT, Grand Total), bank details, service/activity name, manpower roles
Indonesian Faktur Pajak or formal VAT/tax invoice with Tax Invoice Number, Date, VAT/PPN amount
Work progress / Berita Acara with PO Number, period dates, manhour % completion, approval blocks (Prepared, Reviewed, Acknowledged, Approved), service name, manpower roles and names
Manhour summary table with Regular Manhour, Overtime Manhour, roles, and worker names
Daily time sheet with Date, IN/OUT times, Sign Workers, Daily Activity, Approved by, work-order rows. A PO reference number in the header does NOT make this a purchase order
Biometric attendance log (face/finger) with Date, Username, Event (check-in/out, authentication)
Formal SAP purchase order form with PURCHASE ORDER title, PO Number box, PO Date, Vendor Code, Requisition No, line-item pricing — NOT a daily time sheet even if a PO number appears elsewhere
PO appendix or rate schedule with PO header, unit price, quantity, manpower role per line

invoiceTypes.name: Civil Contractor
invoiceTypes.contentSignals: Construction/civil work scope, work progress by construction stage (e.g. Infrastructure, Sport Hall, Shared Block), references to Sertifikat Badan Usaha or Izin Usaha Jasa Konstruksi.

documents.classificationHints: Cover page titled TRANSMITTAL NOTE listing enclosed documents (Inv No, Progress N). Sender/To/Attention/From, document table with Remarks (Original). Not an invoice.
Commercial invoice with Inv No, Date, Payment Terms, totals (Total Amount, VAT, Grand Total), bank details, service/activity name, manpower roles
RECEIPT / Kwitansi-style page with Received From and amount in words, OR Notice of Total Value for a Progress Claim with Payment Details. Not the commercial invoice.
Indonesian Faktur Pajak or formal VAT/tax invoice with Tax Invoice Number, Date, VAT/PPN amount
Work progress / Berita Acara with PO Number, period dates, manhour % completion, approval blocks (Prepared, Reviewed, Acknowledged, Approved), service name, manpower roles and names
Landscape MONTHLY PROGRESS REPORT spreadsheet: PO Line No, Description, WBS No, Weight Factor, Previous/Current/Cumulative %. Not a Berita Acara.
Indonesian Sertifikat Badan Usaha (SBU) Konstruksi / PB-UMKU with Garuda emblem, NIB, KBLI. Not IUJK.
Izin Usaha Jasa Konstruksi Nasional with Nomor IUJK, Nama Perusahaan, NPWP. Not SBU.
Formal SAP purchase order form with PURCHASE ORDER title, PO Number box, PO Date, Vendor Code, Requisition No, line-item pricing — NOT a daily time sheet even if a PO number appears elsewhere
PO appendix or rate schedule with PO header, unit price, quantity, manpower role per line
Formal SAP purchase order form with PURCHASE ORDER title, PO Number box, PO Date, Vendor Code, Requisition No, line-item pricing — NOT a daily time sheet even if a PO number appears elsewhere
PO appendix or rate schedule with PO header, unit price, quantity, manpower role per line
Commercial invoice with Inv No, Date, Payment Terms, totals (Total Amount, VAT, Grand Total), bank details, service/activity name, manpower roles

invoiceTypes.contentSignals: Catering/meal service language, meal counts by type (breakfast, lunch, dinner, supper), attendance/headcount at a camp or site facility.
